Sao Paulo, Brazil — Supporters of Brazil’s right-wing senator and Liberal party presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro hold a giant Brazilian flag during a rally on Paulista Avenue in Sao Paulo. Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began, new government data shows. But whether this globally important success is maintained or reversed is on a knife edge ahead of a presidential election run-off on 25 October between two candidates with sharply different visions for the future of the rainforest and how that affects relations with the US under Donald Trump. — Photograph: Miguel Schincariol/AFP/Getty Images
